scenes.bodyText:
=== GENERAL STATUS EFFECTS & LIFE CYCLE LAB ===

Status effects reflect current states, future biological/magical progressions, and permanent character conditions.

Active Status Effects on you are rendered as badges in your character card HUD with tooltips, durations, and stat influences.

Choose an action to verify:

choices.label: Apply Permanent Blessing (+25% Max Health, +10 Base Health)

=== UNIVERSAL AFFECTION & CORRUPTION SYSTEM (PHASE 3A) ===

All entities track affection (-100.0 to +100.0) and corruption (0.0 to 100.0).
Both meters serialize into JSON saves and gate dialogue options and events via MIN_AFFECTION, MAX_AFFECTION, MIN_CORRUPTION, and MAX_CORRUPTION.

Select a probe or modify stats:

choices.label: Probe: MIN_AFFECTION (Check Player Affection >= -100.0)
choices.tooltip: Verifies player affection meets minimum boundary.

choices.tooltip: Verifies player affection does not exceed upper boundary.

choices.label: Probe: MIN_CORRUPTION (Check Player Corruption >= 0.0)
choices.tooltip: Verifies player corruption meets non-negative baseline.

choices.label: Probe: MAX_CORRUPTION (Check Player Corruption <= 100.0)
choices.tooltip: Verifies player corruption does not exceed maximum cap.

=== SERVANT & CAPTIVE MANAGEMENT LAB (PHASE 1A) ===

Servants feature 24 hourly schedule slots defaulting to 'rest'.
Working jobs ('maid_cleaning', 'farm_hand', 'guard_patrol', 'cook_assistant') consumes stamina and increases obedience.
Reaching 0.0 stamina triggers exhaustion, inflicts morale/affection penalties, and zeroes gold yields.
Resting recovers +15 stamina/hour (enhanced by +5 in luxurious quarters).

Select an action:

choices.label: Spar with Automaton to Subjugate Captive
choices.tooltip: Enter combat; after victory, select 'Subjugate' in the encounter resolution view to recruit a servant.

choices.label: Collect Construction Grant (+5,000 Gold)
choices.tooltip: Receive 5,000 gold to fund room construction and servant accommodations.

scenes.bodyText:
=== BINARY OFFSPRING & NURSERY LAB (PHASE 2A) ===

Offspring feature a binary lifecycle:
- Stage 1: CHILD (0 to 29 days in nursery)
- Stage 2: ADULT_NPC (30+ days, eligible for party combat recruitment)
Offspring inherit parent racial traits and stats.

Select an action:

choices.label: Impregnate Player (Human Father, Litter Size 2, 10 Gestation Days)
choices.tooltip: Induce pregnancy with gestation tracking.

choices.label: Probe: IS_PREGNANT (Verify Gestation Active)
choices.tooltip: Verifies gestation component isPregnant flag.

choices.label: Induce Immediate Childbirth & Register in Nursery
choices.tooltip: Triggers immediate delivery and creates OffspringRecord in nursery.

Equipment items track ItemFluidSoiling (cum, milk, girlcum stains and isDirty flag).
Climax events in intimate encounters stain equipped garments.
Wearing soiled items applies a charisma social penalty.
Washing at a water tile or casting overworld Cleanse purges all stains.

=== COMPOSABLE NPC & 1-TILE CLIENT ROOM LAB (PHASE 2B) ===

Composable NPC Generator synthesizes characters from 3 orthogonal pools:
1. Body Templates (6 species/build archetypes)
2. Outfit Templates (4 tailored clothing ensembles)
3. Professions (4 commercial client classes with gold budgets and fetish desires)

Standing on a service room tile displays the 'Get Client' button on the action grid.

scenes.bodyText:

You may use these funds to test building Tier 1 rooms, branching upgrades (Living Quarters -> Milking Parlor / Service Suite / Nursery), and verifying 50% refund teardowns on customizable tiles (1,4), (2,4), and (3,4).

=== ABLUTION & GARMENT CLEANSING STATION ===

Fresh mountain water ripples through cut stone sluices.

Standing on this water tile activates the 'Wash Garments' button on your exploration action grid, which scrubs all equipped and backpack garments clean of dirt, cum, milk, and fluid stains.

You may also cast the overworld spell 'Purifying Cleanse' outside of combat to cleanse garments anywhere.

=== AUTOMATED MILKING PARLOR ===

Sterile mechanical suction cups and glass collection vessels stand ready.

When standing on an upgraded milking parlor tile (or room with 'milking' tag), the 'Extract Personal Fluids' action appears on your exploration grid. It draws bodily fluids (breast milk, cum, girlcum) and converts them into standardized bottled items loaded from data/config/fluid_harvesting.json.

choices.label: Fill Breasts with Milk (+250 ml)
choices.tooltip: Fill breasts before extraction.

scenes.bodyText:
=== COMMERCIAL SERVICE SUITE ===

Plush velvet divans and discreet silk partitions create an intimate environment for visiting clients.

When standing on this commercial service tile, the 'Get Client' button appears on your exploration action grid. Clicking it dynamically composes a visiting client NPC from the 3-pool generator and begins an intimate CYOA session. Successfully concluding the encounter awards the client's gold budget.
